data.title: SO/ Uptown Residences
data.about:
Elevate Your Living at SO/ Uptown Residences Dubai: Presented by Accor x DMCC, this 28-story masterpiece in Uptown Dubai is where luxury has no bounds. Choose from a range of one to three-bedroom apartments, including two-bedroom duplexes and majestic three-bedroom penthouses, each reflecting elegance for the utmost comfort and style. 

All residence feature cutting-edge design and elegant styling for the highest standards of living. Crafted through the brilliant collaboration of Ennismore and Accor, these 227 residences promise more than just a home. From breathtaking panoramic views to 'Diamond' access to the Live Limitless loyalty programme, every moment here is an experience. 

Along with unparalleled amenities, residents are further pampered with exclusive benefits curated by DMCC. Welcome to the epitome of elegance at SO/ Uptown Residences Dubai.

characteristics_module.title: An Architectural Marvel in Dubai
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• A prestigious joint venture between renowned brands, Ennismore and Accor
  • Boasting 227 luxurious residences spread across 28 floors of the Uptown Dubai Tower
  • Panoramic Dubai Views thanks to the tower's prime location
  • The residences come equipped with amenities that redefine luxury living
  • An exclusive collection of premium residences
  • Residences with  top-tier finishes, deluxe amenities, and sophisticated design
  • Massive glass walls offer residents breathtaking views
  • Direct Access to Shiekh Zayed Road
  • Obtain a Accor Diamond Membership

location_tile.title: Direct connectivity to Sheikh Zayed Road
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Residing at SO/ Uptown puts you at the heart of luxury – be it gourmet dining, high-end shopping, or the exclusive entertainment of The Plaza. It's more than just a home; it's living amidst the epitome of sophistication.

  • 02 Minutes to  DMCC METRO STATION
  • 05 Minutes to BEACH
  • 10 Minutes to PALM JUMEIRAH
  • 15 Minutes to MALL OF THE EMIRATES
  • 20 Minutes to DUBAI MALL
  • 30 Minutes to DXB INTL. AIRPORT
